001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007@HistoryLogProps(
008    opCode = 55,
009    displayName = "Bolus Activated",
010    internalName = "LID_BOLUS_ACTIVATED",
011    usedByTidepool = true
012)
013public class BolusActivatedHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
014
015    private int bolusId;
016    private int selectedIob;
017    private float iob;
018    private float bolusSize;
019
020    public BolusActivatedHistoryLog() {}
021
022    public BolusActivatedHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int selectedIob, float iob, float bolusSize) {
023        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, selectedIob, iob, bolusSize, 0);
024    }
025
026    public BolusActivatedHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int selectedIob, float iob, float bolusSize, int headerHighNibble) {
027        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
028        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, selectedIob, iob, bolusSize, headerHighNibble);
029        this.bolusId = bolusId;
030        this.selectedIob = selectedIob;
031        this.iob = iob;
032        this.bolusSize = bolusSize;
033
034    }
035
036    /**
037     * @deprecated bytes 12-13 of this log are not padding: byte 12 carries selectedIob. This
038     * constructor assumes a selectedIob of 0, which does not round-trip a record where it is 1.
039     */
040    @Deprecated
041    public BolusActivatedHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, float iob, float bolusSize) {
042        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, 0, iob, bolusSize);
043    }
044
045    /**
046     * @deprecated see {@link #BolusActivatedHistoryLog(long, long, int, float, float)}
047     */
048    @Deprecated
049    public BolusActivatedHistoryLog(int bolusId, float iob, float bolusSize) {
050        this(0, 0, bolusId, 0, iob, bolusSize);
051    }
052
053    public int typeId() {
054        return 55;
055    }
056
057    /**
058     * <table border="1">
059     * <caption>Parsed fields for BolusActivatedHistoryLog:</caption>
060     * <tr><td><code>bolusId</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
061     * <tr><td><code>selectedIob</code></td><td><code>raw[12]</code></td></tr>
062     * <tr><td><code>iob</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
063     * <tr><td><code>bolusSize</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
064     * </table>
065     */
066    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
067        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
068        this.cargo = raw;
069        parseBase(raw);
070        this.bolusId = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
071        this.selectedIob = raw[12];
072        this.iob = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 14);
073        this.bolusSize = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 18);
074
075    }
076
077    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int selectedIob, float iob, float bolusSize) {
078        return buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, selectedIob, iob, bolusSize, 0);
079    }
080
081    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int selectedIob, float iob, float bolusSize, int headerHighNibble) {
082        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
083            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(55, headerHighNibble),
084            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
085            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
086            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bolusId),
087            // bytes 12-13: selectedIob followed by one unused byte, which is 0 in every known
088            // record. These were previously omitted entirely, which shifted iob and bolusSize
089            // 2 bytes earlier than parse() reads them.
090            new byte[]{ (byte) selectedIob, 0 },
091            Bytes.toFloat(iob),
092            Bytes.toFloat(bolusSize)));
093    }
094
095    /**
096     * @return the ID of the bolus operation
097     */
098    public int getBolusId() {
099        return bolusId;
100    }
101
102    /**
103     * @return the raw value of byte 12, which tracks the IOB algorithm in use.
104     *
105     * <p>This is an inference drawn from a small number of records, in which byte 12 co-varies
106     * exactly with {@link BolusRequestedMsg2HistoryLog#getSelectedIOB()} for the same bolus. It
107     * should be confirmed against further captures before being relied upon. The byte offsets
108     * either side of it are independently confirmed.
109     */
110    public int getSelectedIob() {
111        return selectedIob;
112    }
113
114    public BolusRequestedMsg2HistoryLog.SelectedIOBType getSelectedIobType() {
115        return BolusRequestedMsg2HistoryLog.SelectedIOBType.fromId(selectedIob);
116    }
117
118    /**
119     * @return current insulin on board
120     */
121    public float getIob() {
122        return iob;
123    }
124
125    /**
126     * @return the size of the bolus which was activated
127     */
128    public float getBolusSize() {
129        return bolusSize;
130    }
131
132}
